## Centinela — Tablero operativo

Seguimiento del pipeline de transacciones: volumen, errores, cola y latencia extremo a extremo. Para trazar una transacción puntual, pegue su `correlationId` en el parámetro.

content.query:
traces
| where message in ("transaction_received", "transaction_scored", "case_created")
| summarize total = count() by bin(timestamp, 15m), etapa = message
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Volumen del pipeline: recibidas / puntuadas / casos

content.query:
union
    (requests | where success == false | project timestamp, stage = cloud_RoleName, tipo = "failed_request"),
    (exceptions | project timestamp, stage = cloud_RoleName, tipo = "exception")
| summarize total = count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), stage
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Errores por etapa (requests fallidos + excepciones)

content.query:
let ingested = requests
    | where cloud_RoleName == "ingestion-api" and success == true
    | project correlationId = tostring(customDimensions.correlationId), tIngesta = timestamp;
let caseCreated = traces
    | where message == "case_created"
    | project correlationId = tostring(customDimensions.correlationId), tCaso = timestamp;
ingested
| join kind=inner caseCreated on correlationId
| extend e2eSegundos = datetime_diff('millisecond', tCaso, tIngesta) / 1000.0
| summarize p50 = percentile(e2eSegundos, 50), p95 = percentile(e2eSegundos, 95) by bin(tIngesta, 15m)
| order by tIngesta asc
content.title: Latencia extremo a extremo: ingesta → apertura de caso (s)

content.query:
union requests, dependencies, traces, exceptions
| where tostring(customDimensions.correlationId) == "{CorrelationId}"
| project timestamp, stage = cloud_RoleName, itemType, detail = coalesce(name, message, type), success, duration, transactionId = tostring(customDimensions.transactionId), caseId = tostring(customDimensions.caseId)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Recorrido de la transacción {CorrelationId}
